reconstruction.scope: Complete mapped coachman’s hut exterior at Yasnaya Polyana: single-storey log cabin with broad thick thatched hip roof, short ridge, one pale capped chimney, two front windows, one short-side window and one physically recessed wooden front door. Nearby levels add coarse log courses/corner ends, simple window bars, ridge hold-down poles and low garden edging interrupted at the supported entrance. All four actual mapped edges are retained. Hidden rear faces, chimney inventory, thatch profile and historic levels remain approximate. No interiors, copied signs, inscriptions, plaques, people, photograph pixels or surrounding plantings.
